metadata.street_name: Avinguda de la Riera de Cassoles

scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a busy intersection in a downtown area with tall buildings and pedestrians walking along the sidewalk. The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines painted on it. There are several vehicles driving down the street including a bus, cars, and a van. The buildings surrounding the street have various architectural styles and designs. Some of the buildings have balconies and windows while others have storefronts. The sky is overcast with clouds covering most of the sun. The street is lined with trees and other greenery. A black trash can is visible in the bottom left corner of the image.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings in the image are primarily made of concrete and brick with some having glass windows. They vary in height and design. Some have balconies and others do not. The buildings appear to be well-maintained but show signs of wear and tear. The street is lined with trees and other greenery. A large scaffolding structure is visible on the right side of the image.
